marcus.title: Marcus savings
marcus.observed: 3.50% APY; as of October 21, 2026; no fees or minimum deposit; apply online or in app.

marcus-security.title: Marcus online banking
marcus-security.observed: Multi-factor authentication, SSL encryption and firewalls; FDIC insured.

marcus-fdic.title: Marcus FAQs
marcus-fdic.observed: Accounts provided by Goldman Sachs Bank USA; combined deposit coverage applies.

marcus-eligibility.title: Marcus deposit agreement
marcus-eligibility.observed: Effective June 27, 2025: age 18+, SSN or ITIN, qualifying street address in US, specified territories or military base/embassy.

referral.title: Marcus referral terms
referral.observed: 3-month 1.00 percentage-point APY boost; recipient must use referral link; standard APY variable. Full eligibility terms require review.

capital.title: Capital One comparison / application destination
capital.observed: 3.20% APY; no fees or minimums; FDIC insured; mobile app. Application URL redirects here.

capital-disclosure.title: Capital One savings disclosure
capital-disclosure.observed: No minimum opening deposit or balance for APY. Some extracted rate values show NaN.

capital-product.title: Capital One savings product
capital-product.observed: Application needs identity, address, contact, employment, annual income, tax ID and citizenship information; 60 days to fund on approval. Extracted APY is NaN.

capital-app.title: Capital One mobile app
capital-app.observed: App security includes two-step authentication and fraud alerts.

capital-merger.title: Discover merger FAQs
capital-merger.observed: Discover merged May 18, 2025; Capital One and Discover deposits jointly insured starting November 18, 2025, with possible CD exceptions.

discover.title: Discover savings transition
discover.observed: Discover savings accounts transitioning to Capital One; account-specific notices determine changes.

ally.title: Ally rates
ally.observed: Savings 3.1% APY as of October 21, 2026; no minimum opening deposit or monthly maintenance fees; limit 10 certain withdrawals/transfers per statement cycle; repeated excess may close account.

ally-product.title: Ally savings
ally-product.observed: FDIC insured to applicable limits; daily compounding.

ally-security.title: Ally security
ally-security.observed: Multi-factor authentication; online/mobile banking unauthorized transaction guarantee conditioned on reporting within 60 days of statement availability.

amex.title: Amex savings and footnotes
amex.observed: 3.20% APY as of October 21, 2026; no minimum deposit or monthly fees; daily compounding; Amex app; American Express National Bank Member FDIC. Identity verification then online registration and funding.

amex-security.title: Amex savings security
amex-security.observed: Encryption, mandatory MFA and automatic logout after 5 minutes inactivity.

synchrony.title: Synchrony savings
synchrony.observed: Headline 3.55% APY but embedded calculator 2.85%. No minimum deposit/balance/monthly fees; mobile app, FDIC insurance, 24/7 monitoring. Rate excluded pending resolution.

chase.title: Chase Savings
chase.observed: Monthly fee $5; one waiver is $300 balance at beginning of each day. Chase Mobile app; other waivers apply. No location-specific APY confirmed.

bofa.title: Bank of America fee schedule
bofa.observed: Effective August 7, 2026: Advantage Savings $100 opening deposit, $8 monthly fee; new account six-month fee waiver; $500 daily balance is one ongoing waiver.

wells.title: Wells Fargo Way2Save
wells.observed: Opening deposit $25; monthly fee $5, waived with $300 daily minimum or other conditions; age 18+ to apply online, IDs required.

citi.title: Citi Savings
citi.observed: Product/pricing based on home address; extracted APY unresolved placeholder; mobile app and FDIC insurance. $500 average monthly balance or checking account are fee-waiver paths.

fdic.title: FDIC coverage
fdic.observed: Standard $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, per ownership category. Same-category deposits at same bank are aggregated.

fdic-interest.title: FDIC principal and interest
fdic-interest.observed: Coverage includes principal and accrued interest.

edie.title: FDIC EDIE
edie.observed: Ownership categories and coverage limits; actual coverage depends on account structure.

accounts.name: Bank of America • Advantage Savings
accounts.monthly_fee_notes: $8; $500 daily minimum waives; first 6 months waived

accounts.name: Citi • Savings / Accelerate
accounts.monthly_fee_notes: $500 average monthly balance or checking waives; fee amount unverified
